analysis: I will inspect Ahri's actual arena cast and projectile collision handling, then build a scenario comparing outward and return damage at different simulation step sizes with a stationary target and a no-hit control.

scenario.title: Ahri orb per-pass hit accounting
scenario.expectedBehavior: A stationary enemy takes one hit outward and one returning, independent of simulation step size; an enemy outside the orb path takes no damage.
